text:
noah: heads-up — since ~14:10 UTC we're seeing sustained remote_write backoff from prometheus in us-east-1, queue_length climbing and spikes in ingest latency. Grafana panel here: https://grafana.internal/r/PromRemWrite (chart shows queue > 20k)
maria: this started after the relabel changes from yesterday's rollout? which cluster/tenant is affected?
noah: looks like cluster `gpu-pool-eu` and `gpu-pool-us` but only tenants using the new gpu exporter. logs from prometheus-sidecar:
noah: ```
level=warn ts=2025-11-20T14:12:08.123Z caller=queue_manager.go:312 component=remote queue=0/1/20000 msg="backoff after error" err="rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = write buffer full"
```
derek: hmm, ResourceExhausted + backoff usually means remote write endpoint (cortex) is throttling or our batch sizes/tuning is off. Any relabel rules that increased series cardinality?
noah: yes — the gpu exporter landed a relabel that preserves `container_id` -> that exploded card. new samples show many ephemeral container ids per node.
maria: ack. if cardinality jump is the root cause, we should drop container-specific labels at scrape time for that job.
yang: quick check: run `curl -sS http://prom-us-east:9090/api/v1/status/tsdb` and `/_status/target?state=active` to see scrape targets and cardinalities. also check remote_write queue metrics:
yang: ```
prometheus_remote_storage_queue_length{job="prometheus"}
prometheus_remote_storage_max_samples_sent
```
noah: i ran `promtool tsdb analyze` on a snapshot — series count for `gpu_exporter` jumped x15 after relabel change.
sre-bot: incident created: #INC-2025-442 -> "prom remwrite backoff — gpu exporter cardinality" assigned to @derek :rotating_light:
liz: proposed relabel to add to gpu exporter scrape config — drop instance/container labels and keep only `node` and `gpu_index`:
liz: ```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_container_name"]
    action: replace
    target_label: container_name
  - source_labels: ["container_id"]
    action: drop
  - regex: "(node-.*|gpu-.*)"
    action: keep
```
maria: small nit — prefer explicit `action: labeldrop` pattern to be safe. something like:
maria: ```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - action: labeldrop
    regex: "container(id|_).*|pod_template_hash"
```
derek: i'll prepare a canary: add labeldrop on prometheus-canary in us-east with relaxed remote_write timeout, and reduce `max_samples_per_send` to smaller batch to avoid huge bursts. also notify cortex team for rate limits.
noah: suggested remote_write tweaks (quick):
noah: ```yaml
remote_write:
  - url: https://cortex.internal/api/prom/push
    timeout: 30s
    queue_config:
      max_shards: 2
      max_samples_per_send: 500
      capacity: 50000
```
yang: also enable `relabel_configs` to drop high-card labels before relabeling to external metric names (otherwise card still spikes in TSDB).
liz: timeline: canary relabel today, monitor 1h, then rollout. I'll add dashboard panel showing `prometheus_target_series` per job and `remote_write_queue_length` and alert if queue > 5k for >5m.
maria: set alert to fire on `sum(prometheus_remote_storage_queue_length) by (cluster) > 5000 for 5m` and severity=page for prod clusters. Warnings for non-prod.
noah: operational playbook notes I added to the incident: how to rollback (relabel removal), how to pause remote_write on canary prometheus with `services/prometheus toggle` script.
derek: assigning follow-up ticket INFRA-7892 to me for relabel change, queue tuning, and postmortem. I'll coordinate with cortex on quotas. blocking: need quick approval to patch canary.
maria: approved. go ahead with canary and post status here. :thumbsup:
noah: doing rollout now — patch pushed to `prom-canary-us-east` and restarted with graceful drain. watching metrics.
sre-bot: alert cleared for `prom_remote_write_backoff_us-east` at 14:22 UTC
noah: queue_length dropped from ~22k to 1.2k after canary relabel applied. spikes still possible but much better.
liz: will draft a short KB about relabel hygiene for exporters that create ephemeral ids. common rules and example configs.
maria: nice work team. we should include relabel checks in CI (detect label explosion). file follow-up RFC to standardize labelset for all infra exporters.
derek: will post PR with config and add a smoke test for series count regression.
noah: closing thread when PR merged. thanks everyone. :party-parrot:
